difficulty_basis: Engineering complexity, not calibrated model pass rates: L1 single datapath; L2 state and fault handling; L3 multi-clock or segmented integration.

template.input: The named interface/implementation, its trusted self-checking testbench, and any failing log from the candidate run.
template.deliverable: A patch to implementation files, a concise failure explanation, and a fresh source-bound simulation receipt.
template.fixed_evaluator: Do not edit the testbench, runner, completion marker, or acceptance thresholds to obtain a pass.
template.evaluation: The trusted runner checks tool completion; the exporter validates receipt/source/log integrity and the bench outcome. Physical metrics and process rewards are separate and unavailable in this receipt format.

tasks.title: CRC32C byte ordering and known-answer verification
tasks.specification: Preserve the CRC update interface and produce the expected CRC for the independent known-answer vector.

tasks.title: Clock ownership, safety stop and explicit re-arm
tasks.specification: Keep complete clock pulses under normal start/stop phase variation; safety stop forces high impedance, and clearing it cannot enable output without a fresh arm.
oracle_anchors: kill clear enabled without fresh arm

tasks.title: Validate a frame before publishing payload
tasks.specification: Deliver the expected payload for valid frames, reject CRC/sequence faults without publishing their payload, and abort an in-flight transfer on reset.
oracle_anchors: mid-transaction reset failed to abort TX

tasks.title: Full-duplex multi-clock endpoint integration
tasks.specification: Preserve byte-exact bidirectional transfers and frame accounting across the composed clock domains and configured buffering.

tasks.title: Segmented packet ownership and halt/resume
tasks.specification: Respect packet boundaries and segmented offsets; a falling-ready halt and later resume must neither replay nor lose a transmitted word. Preserve the atomic management interface.
